correctness.rationale: Rebuilt Petersen as KG(5,2), enumerated all 120 spanning-path nine-edge facets and all 10212 faces including empty (nonempty f-vector 15,105,445,1245,2346,2905,2190,840,120). Independent 15-edge toggle Morse matching yields 5092 pairs on augmented poset, four critical dimension-five and 24 dimension-six cells, one paired empty/vertex; topological sort visits all 10212 face vertices. Recomputed exact signed integer gradient-path 4x24 Morse boundary: all zero. Since 5-skeleton wedge^4 S5 is 4-connected, Hurewicz identifies pi5 with H5, so all degree-zero attaching maps for 6-cells are null and integral homotopy is the stated wedge. Independently enumerated 10372 acyclic degree<=2 edge sets, 160 nonextendibles, minimal-size counts 10 and30; input checker separately tests S5 orbits. Finite exhaustive, no general-graph extrapolation.
residual_risks: Vanishing mod-two homology alone would not imply integral wedge; independent exact signed Morse boundary was necessary and checked.
The inclusion-minimal obstruction proof is exact for 2^15 masks only and graph-aut group action is assessed for KG(5,2).
